25–26 July 2026– May 2027 | winners = | relegated = | continentalcup1 = | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | continentalcup3 = | continentalcup3 qualifiers = | matches = 52 | total goals = 180 | league topscorer = [[Matej Trusa]] (7) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2025–26 Slovak First Football League|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Slovak First Football League|2027–28]] | updated = 21 September 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Slovak First Football League''' (known as '''Niké liga''' for sponsorship reasons) is the 34th season of first-tier football league in [[Slovakia]] since its establishment in 1993. The season started on 25–26 July 2026 and end in May 2027.{{Cite web |title=Nový ročník Niké ligy 2026/2027 odštartuje na konci júla |url=https://www.nikeliga.sk/clanok/4505-novy-rocnik-nike-ligy-2026-2027-odstartuje-na-konci-jula |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=Niké liga}} There will be no fixtures between 13 December 2026 and 7 February 2027.{{Cite web |title=Niké liga: Najdôležitejšie dátumy budúcej sezóny 2025/2026 {{!}} Flashscore.sk |url=https://www.flashscore.sk/spravy/futbal-nike-liga-nike-liga-pozna-najdolezitejsie-datumy-buducej-sezony-2025-2026/nBmdepzA/ |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=www.flashscore.sk |language=sk}} [[ŠK Slovan Bratislava|Slovan Bratislava]] is the eighth-time defending champion.{{Cite web |date=2026-05-02 |title=Slovan Bratislava vystúpal na majstrovský trón: Proti DAC zaknihoval 8. titul v rade |url=https://sport24.pluska.sk/futbal/slovan-bratislava-vystupal-na-majstrovsky-tron-proti-dac-zaknihoval-8-titul-v-rade |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=Šport24.sk |language=sk}} == Summary == === Developments === On 14 November 2025, a decision was made by the Presidium of the Union of League Clubs, approving the schedule for the 2026–27 season.{{Cite web |title=Nová sezóna najvyššej súťaže sa začne posledný júlový víkend. Všetko zostane po starom |url=https://sportnet.sme.sk/spravy/futbal-terminy-schvalenie-unia-ligovych-klubov-nike-liga-2026-2027/ |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=sportnet.sme.sk |language=sk}}{{Cite web |last=Teraz.sk |date=2025-11-14 |title=Nový ročník NL odštartuje na konci júla |url=https://www.teraz.sk/sport/novy-rocnik-nl-odstartuje-na-konci-j/920626-clanok.html |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=TERAZ.sk |language=sk}} The competition model will remain unchanged, and the season will take place in the same span of the autumn and spring parts for the fifth time.{{Cite web |title=Nový ročník Niké ligy odštartuje v júli, model súťaže zostáva rovnaký |url=https://www.denniksport.sk/futbal/c/nike-liga-novy-rocnik-start-koniec-jula |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=Denník Šport |language=sk}}{{Cite web |last=a.s |first=SITA Slovenská tlačová agentúra |date=2025-11-14 |title=Ďalšia sezóna slovenskej I. ligy sa začne tradične koncom júla |url=https://sita.sk/dalsia-sezona-slovenskej-i-ligy-sa-zacne-tradicne-koncom-jula/ |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=SITA.sk |language=sk}} The last autumn round will take place on December 12 and 13, 2026, following a break until February 2027.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-14 |title=Dôležité termíny Niké ligy v sezóne 2026/2027: Model súťaže zostáva nezmenený |url=https://sportky.zoznam.sk/c/434551/ |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=Športky.sk |language=sk}} The eighth round of the league will start a day earlier, on 30 April 2027 due to the final of the Slovak Cup being scheduled for 1 May 2027.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-14 |title=Niké liga bude pokračovať v zabehnutom formáte. ÚLK schválila program na budúcu sezónu {{!}} TVNOVINY.sk |url=https://tvnoviny.sk/nike-liga/clanok/998905-nike-liga-bude-pokracovat-v-zabehnutom-formate-ulk-schvalila-program-na-buducu-sezonu |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=tvnoviny.sk |language=sk}} ==Teams== === Team changes === The following teams have changed division since the 2025–26 season. {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | {| class="wikitable" |+To First Division !{{Increase}} Promoted from [[2025–26 2. O zostupe Tatrana Prešov rozhodol sporný moment, Komárno do baráže |url=https://sport.aktuality.sk/futbal/clanok/nike-liga-kfc-komarno-fc-tatran-presov-2026051616212549448 |access-date=2026-05-16 |website=Šport.sk}} |} |} Twelve teams will compete in the league. The only promoted team is [[MFK Dukla Banská Bystrica|Dukla Banská Bystrica]], returning to the top flight after an absence of one season.{{Cite web |title=Dukla zvládla sezónu systémom štart–cieľ. Tréner Jarábek: Každú súťaž je ťažké vyhrať |url=https://sportnet.sme.sk/spravy/futbal-mfk-dukla-banska-bystrica-reakcie-postup-monacobet-liga-2025-2026/ |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=sportnet.sme.sk |language=sk}}{{Cite web |last=ljstudiocreatives |title=Dukla je späť medzi elitou. Suverénny triumf spečatil postup |url=https://mfkdukla.sk/aktuality/dukla-je-spat-medzi-elitou-suverenny-triumf-specatil-postup |access-date=2026-05-14 |website=mfkdukla.sk |language=sk}} Following a 1–0 defeat to Komárno, with a 92nd minute equalizer being disallowed, Tatran Prešov were relegated to the second division.{{Cite web |date=2026-05-16 |title=Niké liga: Prešov končí v najvyššej súťaži, Komárno smeruje do baráže |url=https://sport24.pluska.sk/futbal/kfc-komarno-fc-tatran-presov-online-dnes-skupina-o-udrzanie-sa-live-futbal |access-date=2026-05-16 |website=Šport24.sk |language=sk}} [[ŠK Slovan Bratislava|Slovan Bratislava]] will enter upcoming season as defending champions for the eighth successive year.{{Cite web |title=Slovan kraľuje Slovensku už osem rokov. Komárno sa odpichlo z dna a môže sa vyhnúť aj baráži |url=https://sportnet.sme.sk/spravy/futbal-slovensko-sumar-8-kolo-nadstavbova-cast-nike-liga-2025-2026/ |access-date=2026-05-14
